intelligence.enrichment: Unknown angles in figures with intersecting lines, parallel lines, and transversals are found by chaining the applicable facts: linear pairs sum to 180 degrees, vertically opposite angles are equal, corresponding and alternate angles on parallel lines are equal, same-side interior angles on parallel lines sum to 180 degrees, and perpendicular angles measure 90 degrees.
